name: WishBone Medical, Inc.
old_description: WishBone Medical is a Warsaw, IN, based pediatric orthopedic company focused globally on the unmet needs of children suffering from orthopedic issues. Our mission is to provide anatomically appropriate solutions in single-use, sterile packed procedure kits to surgeons and their patients who are still growing.
about:
WishBone Medical operates from Warsaw, Indiana, the heart of the orthopedic manufacturing corridor. The company was established to address unmet needs in pediatric orthopedics, focusing on children who are still growing.

The company designs and supplies anatomically appropriate implants and instruments packaged as single-use, sterile procedure kits. Its product lines include growth control systems, plating systems, and bone void fillers, all delivered in multi-barrier sterile packaging. Instruments such as screwdrivers and depth gauges are included in each kit, eliminating the need for reusable trays and loaner sets.

WishBone Medical serves pediatric orthopedic surgeons, hospitals, and surgical centers. Its kits are used in procedures for children with orthopedic conditions, providing a sterile, ready-to-use alternative to traditional reusable instrument sets.

The company emphasizes that its single-use model reduces infection risk, cuts operating room turnover time by eliminating set reprocessing, and avoids the logistical burden of loaner trays. Every instrument is new and sharp for each procedure, and kits are stocked for immediate availability.
